headline: Teachers sound the alarm on homework and critical thinking
digest: A Fraser Institute/Leger survey of 756 grade 6–12 teachers (reported by The Hub) found 95.6% think some students use AI on take-home work and 83.6% see declining critical thinking. Canadian Heritage published what it heard at the first National Summit on AI and Culture, where Indigenous-led and sovereign AI and cultural-sector AI literacy were central themes. Mila partnered with Télé-Québec, and the Raspberry Pi Foundation is building a course for an AI-focused qualification in England.
